label: Outlook / Microsoft 365
terms_note: Automation allowed with delegated (user-consented Mail.Read / Mail.ReadWrite / Mail.Send) or application permissions (admin consent, tenant-wide unless scoped by an application access policy). Personal (outlook.com) and organisation accounts. Outlook service throttling per app-id + mailbox: 10,000 requests per 10 minutes, 4 concurrent requests, 150 MB upload per 5 minutes. Change-notification subscriptions on message resources expire after at most 10,080 minutes (< 7 days); rich notifications with resource data 1,440 minutes; any expiry under 45 minutes is bumped to 45. In-place archive mailboxes are not accessible.

sdks: Microsoft Graph SDKs (msgraph-sdk-python, msgraph-sdk-javascript, .NET, Java, Go) — learn.microsoft.com/graph

auth: 1. Microsoft Entra app registration (multi-tenant or single) → authorization-code flow (MSAL) → refresh token.
2. Delegated permissions: `Mail.Read`, `Mail.ReadWrite`, `Mail.Send` (user consent). Application permissions exist
3. `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; prefer `Prefer: IdType="ImmutableId"` — plain ids change on move / copy.

adapter.rate_note: Outlook service limit: 10,000 requests per 10 minutes per app per mailbox, 4 concurrent requests; HTTP 429 + Retry-After (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/throttling-limits).

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Application (client) ID of the Microsoft Entra app registration.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: Client secret of the app registration ('Only required for web apps'); leave empty for a public client. Sent in the form body of POST https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/v2.0/token.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token from a one-time authorization-code consent including offline_access and the delegated scopes User.Read Mail.ReadWrite Mail.Send. Microsoft may return a new refresh token on every refresh; the runtime keeps it in memory and, with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR set, saves it to <dir>/<platform>.json (mode 0600).

list_inbound.note: Inbox, newest first. Graph pages through @odata.nextLink and says 'Don't try to extract the $skip value', so `page` is ignored; `since` is not sent. text is bodyPreview ('The first 255 characters of the message body'); thread_id is conversationId.

get_thread.note: All messages of a conversation (`thread_id` = conversationId from list_inbound) via an OData $filter; `page` is ignored.

send.note: sendMail in JSON (plain-text body, one recipient `to`); answers 202 with no body, so no message id: 'A 202 Accepted response code indicates that the request has been accepted; however, it doesn't indicate that the request processing has completed'.

reply.note: `thread_id` is the MESSAGE id to reply to (a message `id`, not conversationId); the reply goes to its sender with `text` as the comment. 202, no body.

mark_read.note: PATCH isRead=true on one message (`message_id` required).
